paragraphs: Lowe's Companies, Inc. ( LOHZ) is an American retail company specializing in home improvement. Headquartered in Mooresville, North Carolina, the company operates a chain of retail stores in the United States. As of October 28, 2022, Lowe's and its related businesses operated 2,181 home improvement and hardware stores in North America.

Lowe's is the second-largest hardware chain in the United States (previously the largest in the U.S. until surpassed by Home Depot in 1989) behind rival the Home Depot and ahead of Menards. It is also the second-largest hardware chain in the world, also behind the Home Depot, but ahead of European retailers Leroy Merlin, B&Q, and OBI.

The company previously operated in Australia through the Masters Home Improvement joint venture until 2016, in Mexico until 2019, and in Canada until selling its operations (which will be consolidated under the Rona brand) to Sycamore Partners in 2023.

people.name: Marvin R. Ellison
people.title: Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Served as Lowe's President and Chief Executive Officer from July 2018 to May 2021. Previously served as Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of J.C. Penney and Executive Vice President - U.S. Stores at The Home Depot.

people.name: William P. Boltz
people.title: Executive Vice President, Merchandising
people.bio: Previously served as President and CEO of Chervon North America from 2015 to 2018 and President and owner of The Boltz Group from 2013 to 2015. Also held merchandising leadership roles at The Home Depot.
people.quote: William P. Boltz | | 63 | | Executive Vice President, Merchandising since August 2018;

people.name: Janice M. Dupr
people.title: Executive Vice President, Human Resources
people.bio: Previously held talent management, leadership development and global chief diversity officer roles at Lowe's. Served as Vice President of Diversity & Inclusion and Chief Diversity Officer at McKesson from June 2015 to October 2017.
people.quote: Janice M. Dupr | | 61 | | Executive Vice President, Human Resources since June 2020;

people.name: Seemantini Godbole
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Digital and Information Officer
people.bio: Served as Lowe's Executive Vice President, Chief Information Officer from November 2018 to September 2022. Previously held digital and marketing technology leadership roles at Target.
people.quote: Seemantini Godbole | | 56 | | Executive Vice President, Chief Digital and Information Officer since September 2022;

people.name: Joseph M. McFarland III
people.title: Executive Vice President, Stores
people.bio: Previously served as Executive Vice President, Chief Customer Officer and Executive Vice President, Stores at J.C. Penney. Served as a Divisional President at The Home Depot from 2007 to 2015.
people.quote: Joseph M. McFarland III | | 56 | | Executive Vice President, Stores since August 2018;

people.name: Juliette W. Pryor
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer and Corporate Secretary
people.bio: Served as Lowe's Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer, Chief Compliance Officer and Corporate Secretary from May 2023 to March 2024. Previously held senior legal leadership roles at Albertsons, Cox Enterprises and US Foods.

people.name: Brandon J. Sink
people.title: Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Previously served as Lowe's Senior Vice President, Retail Finance from March 2021 to April 2022. Earlier roles included Vice President positions in merchandising finance, enterprise strategy and finance, and Vice President, Corporate Controller.
people.quote: Brandon J. Sink | | 48 | | Executive Vice President, Chief Financial Officer since April 2022;

people.name: Margrethe R. Vagell
people.title: Executive Vice President, Supply Chain
people.bio: Served as Lowe's Senior Vice President, Supply Chain from January to March 2024. Previously held leadership roles in general merchandising, store merchandising, customer operations, enterprise analytics, and pricing and promotions.
people.quote: Margrethe R. Vagell | | 48 | | Executive Vice President, Supply Chain since March 2024;

people.name: Quonta D. Vance
people.title: Executive Vice President, Pro and Home Services
people.bio: Previously served at Lowe's as Senior Vice President, Transportation and Final Mile; Senior Vice President, General Merchandising Manager; and Division President. Served as Regional Vice President at The Home Depot from February 2001 to May 2018.
